title: Genetic organization and regulation of a meta cleavage pathway for catechols produced from catabolism of toluene, benzene, phenol, and cresols by Pseudomonas pickettii PKO1.
read_scope: Complete indexed primary abstract and bibliographic/fullTextUrl metadata; full main text not obtained in this task
interpretation: Direct abstract supports seven mapped catechol meta-cleavage enzyme genes, phenol/m-cresol induction and condition-specific regulation by tbuS in cloned constructs. The abstract does not assign the terminal acylating acetaldehyde dehydrogenase gene; do not infer every final step in PKO1 from this source alone.
